title: ToolResultRecord
description: Host-neutral input contract representing an already-executed tool result

call_id.description: Unique identifier of the tool call

result_position.description: Sequence position of the result within the same call

content.description: Original raw text content produced by the tool

invocation.description: Filtered tool name and serialized arguments

invocation_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of canonical invocation identity

status.description: Execution status reported by host or runner

host_handle.description: Opaque host identifier preserved and echoed back in replacement plan
